## Slate overview
There are two NLDS Game 2s today. Padres at Brewers is at 4:00 PM ET on FS1. Braves at Dodgers is at 8:00 PM ET on FS1, with L.A. up 1-0 after a 5-3 Game 1 win behind Tarik Skubal ([ESPN recap](https://www.espn.com/mlb/recap/_/gameId/401908007)).

## Best bets

### Brewers moneyline (-142) vs. Padres - 1 unit
- **Win probability 61% vs. 58.7% implied.**
- The pitching matchup favors Milwaukee: Logan Henderson (11-3, 2.47 ERA, 3.32 FIP) against Michael King (12-10, 3.21 ERA, 4.13 FIP) ([Brew Crew Ball](https://www.brewcrewball.com/milwaukee-brewers-game-information/90756/2026-nlds-series-preview-milwaukee-brewers-vs-san-diego-padres)). King's FIP is almost a run worse than his ERA, which points to regression risk.
- Home field at American Family Field.
- Published win probabilities put Milwaukee around 62%, which is about -163 fair, against the -142 price ([Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/mlb/2026-mlb-nlds-brewers-padres-odds)).
- Playable to -150.

## Leans & passes
- **Dodgers -147 vs. Braves:** pass for now. Atlanta has not confirmed Chris Sale on short rest after he threw 95 pitches Tuesday and 21 more Thursday ([MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/news/chris-sale-pitching-plan-nlds-vs-dodgers)). If Grant Holmes starts instead, the Dodgers become a lean up to about -165 behind Blake Snell (11.6 K/9). If Sale goes, pass.
- **Totals:** no edge at 7.5 in L.A.

## Risks
- Playoff bullpen usage is aggressive, so a short Henderson outing hands the game to relievers.
- Lineups and prices came from search snippets. Confirm them before betting.

picks.summary: Henderson's 3.32 FIP vs King's 4.13 at home; fair price near -160.
